children: Zhaojin Mining Industry's earnings will likely remain under pressure till 2028 on higher production costs and lower gold output, Citi analyst Jimmy Feng says in a note. Higher safety checks after mine accidents earlier this year cut output and held up construction of its new Haiyu mine by 3-4 months, Feng says. The bank lowers its target price to 32.00 Hong Kong dollars from HK$41.40 to factor in its 33%-53% cut in earnings estimates for 2026-2028. Citi keeps a buy rating, however, saying Zhaojin Mining's costs will fall once the Haiyu mine starts operating in mid-2028. Shares are down 5.9% at HK$13.85. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
